capabilities: Continue and steer Claudian conversations from a mobile device
Follow streaming replies, Markdown, and execution logs
Respond to permission requests for the running task
Send photos and files as attachments from the phone
Search, switch, and archive conversations in a history panel
disambiguation: Not a standalone AI chat plugin; it only provides remote access to a working Claudian installation on a Mac and includes no model service.
extras: Documentation and troubleshooting guides are in Chinese; this private_beta release has pending real-device acceptance testing, requires separately installed version-matched Mac background services, and does not claim end-to-end encryption on the user-owned server route.
intentEvidence: Claudian is the plugin that executes tasks on your computer; Claudian Remote gives you remote access to it.
problem: Claudian agent tasks run only on the Mac, so users away from the computer cannot continue, monitor, or feed materials into an ongoing task.
